prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1289; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows scraping and a crease along the right rear quarter panel, with the rear bumper cover cracked at its outer edge and the right taillight housing displaced. The damage pattern lines up with a sideswipe during a lane change, and the marks run in a consistent direction along the body. The plan is to replace the rear bumper cover, repair and refinish the quarter panel, and swap the taillight assembly. The labor hours requested fit this scope of work. Nothing in the file points to earlier damage on this vehicle, and the shop invoices show no repeated charges for the same operations.
